provenance.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a refined original editorial illustration for a Project Odisha essay about Odia writer Godabarish Mahapatra and the satirical periodical Niankhunta. This is a conceptual image of writing and publication, NOT a portrait, NOT a reproduction of an issue, and NOT a reconstruction of a historical office. Landscape composition, cream paper background, hand-drawn graphite and restrained ink-wash colour. An open, simply folded small paper periodical lies beside a dark fountain pen and a modest stack of folded sheets. Printed areas are suggested only by loose abstract grey strokes, with no legible letters, invented script, masthead, dates, signatures or logos. A small warm red-orange ink accent at the edge of a page suggests the sting of satire, without literal flames, burning paper or damage. Ordinary paper folds and plausible pen construction; selective hand-made detail, quiet available light, no decorative clutter or staged nostalgia. Keep all principal objects fully within the frame. Calm, thoughtful and readable at preview size, generous breathing room, clearly illustrated rather than photorealistic. Do not depict any person.
